## What's new in 0.5.1

### Added
- When an episode can't load, the player offers Try again.

### Changed
- Timeline previews are always on; their switch in the player's menu is gone.

### Fixed
- Subtitles that fail to download are tried again, and the subtitle menu offers Retry if they still can't load.
- On the Mac, the timeline no longer follows the mouse after you let go of it.
- On phones, letting go of the timeline now jumps the video there.
- On the Mac, a video that goes black (with sound) after full screen or time away loads its picture again by itself.


## Install

**Windows:** download **B-Anime-Setup-0.5.1.exe** below and run it. It installs for your user only, without admin rights. Already have B-Anime? It updates itself.

> **Windows says "Windows protected your PC"?** Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. B-Anime isn't code-signed yet, so Windows doesn't know the publisher. The installer is the one built by this repository's release workflow; you can check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

**Android:** download **B-Anime-0.5.1-arm64.apk** below (arm64, for most phones). The first time, your phone asks you to allow installing from this source. Installed copies update themselves.

**Mac (Apple Silicon):** `brew install --cask ahmedanjum30/tap/b-anime`. Or download **B-Anime-0.5.1-macos.zip** below, unzip it and drag the app to Applications; the first time, right-click it and choose **Open**. Installed copies update themselves.
